# Course completion certificates

**Twenty-seven of the twenty-eight things Claude Academy publishes behind the certification program, completed by [Amey Thakur](https://github.com/Amey-Thakur).** Twenty-six courses and the tutorial; Introduction to evals was published in November 2026 and has no completion record here yet. Twenty-six of the twenty-seven issued a completion badge, twenty-seven badges in all because one course issued two, and twenty-two also issued a certificate. AI Fluency for pK-12 Train the Trainer issues neither, which is why the galleries are shorter than the catalog.

Every certificate links to its issued PDF and its Skilljar verification record.
